aws.title: S3 Bucket Misconfiguration
aws.description: Publicly accessible S3 buckets exposing sensitive data
aws.mitigation: Block public access, bucket policies, encryption at rest, access logging

aws.title: IAM Over-Privileged Roles
aws.description: IAM roles with excessive permissions violating least privilege
aws.mitigation: Regular IAM audits, use IAM Access Analyzer, principle of least privilege

aws.title: Lambda Function Injection
aws.description: Serverless functions vulnerable to injection attacks
aws.mitigation: Input validation, use Lambda layers securely, environment variable encryption

aws.title: RDS Snapshot Exposure
aws.description: Database snapshots shared publicly or with unauthorized accounts
aws.mitigation: Encrypt snapshots, restrict sharing, regular snapshot audits

aws.title: EC2 Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) Abuse
aws.description: SSRF attacks accessing EC2 metadata to steal credentials
aws.mitigation: Use IMDSv2, disable metadata endpoint if not needed, network policies

aws.title: CloudTrail Logging Disabled
aws.description: Audit logging disabled, preventing detection of malicious activity
aws.mitigation: Enable CloudTrail in all regions, log file validation, centralized logging

azure.title: Azure Storage Account Public Access
azure.mitigation: Disable public access, use SAS tokens, enable firewall rules

azure.title: Managed Identity Misconfiguration
azure.mitigation: Least privilege, regular reviews, use Azure AD PIM

azure.title: Key Vault Secrets Exposure
azure.description: Secrets accessible to unauthorized users or applications
azure.mitigation: Access policies, RBAC, audit logging, secret rotation

gcp.title: GCS Bucket AllUsers Permission
gcp.description: Cloud Storage buckets accessible to all internet users
gcp.mitigation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers, use IAM conditions, uniform bucket-level access

gcp.title: Service Account Key Exposure
gcp.description: Service account keys leaked or stored insecurely
gcp.mitigation: Use Workload Identity, rotate keys, avoid downloading keys

gcp.title: Compute Engine Default Service Account
gcp.description: VMs using default service account with editor role
gcp.mitigation: Create custom service accounts, minimal permissions, disable default SA

kubernetes.title: Exposed Kubernetes Dashboard
kubernetes.mitigation: Disable dashboard, use RBAC, require authentication, network policies

kubernetes.title: Privileged Container
kubernetes.description: Containers running with privileged flag or root user
kubernetes.mitigation: Drop capabilities, use security contexts, Pod Security Standards

kubernetes.title: Secrets in Environment Variables
kubernetes.description: Sensitive data exposed in container environment variables
kubernetes.mitigation: Use Kubernetes Secrets, external secret managers, encrypt etcd

kubernetes.title: Unrestricted Network Policies
kubernetes.description: Pods can communicate with any other pod without restrictions
kubernetes.mitigation: Implement NetworkPolicies, zero-trust networking, service mesh

kubernetes.title: Vulnerable Container Images
kubernetes.mitigation: Image scanning, admission controllers, use minimal base images
